title.ur: Outdoor central-coil temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: Outdoor central coil sensor open/short (U-MATCH-specific code).
meaning.ur: Outdoor central coil sensor khula/short hai (U-MATCH ka khaas code).

causes.ur: Sensor open ya short ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch off power before removing the outdoor coil sensor.
solutions.ur: Outdoor coil sensor nikalne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the thermistor connector and measure its resistance against the manual chart.
solutions.ur: Thermistor ka connector dobara lagayein aur manual ke chart ke mutabiq uska resistance naapein.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor if it is open or short.
solutions.ur: Sensor open ya short ho to badlein.

title.en: Over-voltage protection (U-MATCH alias of P1 high)
title.ur: Over-voltage protection (U-MATCH mein P1 high ka alias)

meaning.en: Supply >260 V AC trips; recovers when V >155 V.
meaning.ur: Supply 260 V AC se upar jaye to trip; V 155 V se upar jaye to wapas chalta hai.

solutions.en: Measure L/N; wait for recovery
solutions.ur: L/N naapein aur voltage theek hone ka intezar karein

solutions.en: Fit voltage stabilizer if grid unstable
solutions.ur: Grid unstable ho to voltage stabilizer lagayein

source.title: TCL U-MATCH-R32 Series Service Manual (TCC-* duct/cassette/floor multi; code tables p95–96, troubleshooting p97–112)

notes.ur: §3.3.7 mein J8/J9 use hota hai, jabke doosri series P1 dikhati hai. Har code ka source service_manual hai.

title.en: Under-voltage protection (U-MATCH alias of P1 low)
title.ur: Under-voltage protection (U-MATCH mein P1 low ka alias)

meaning.en: Supply <150 V AC trips; recovers when V >155 V.
meaning.ur: Supply 150 V AC se neeche jaye to trip; V 155 V se upar jaye to wapas chalta hai.

solutions.en: Turn the unit off, then measure the supply at the terminals with a multimeter before any other work.
solutions.ur: Pehle unit band karein, phir multimeter se terminal par supply naapein.

solutions.en: Wait for the grid to recover and keep the unit off until the voltage is back in range.
solutions.ur: Grid theek hone ka intezar karein aur voltage wapas range mein na aa jaye tab tak unit band rakhein.

solutions.en: Fit a voltage stabilizer if the local supply keeps dipping.
solutions.ur: Agar supply baar baar kam ho to voltage stabilizer lagayein.

title.en: Module temperature protection (U-MATCH alias of F7)
title.ur: Module temperature protection (U-MATCH mein F7 ka alias)

meaning.en: IPM >95 °C — same trip as F7, shown as J6 in U-MATCH troubleshooting.
meaning.ur: IPM 95°C se aopar — F7 ki trh

causes.ur: Heatsink ka contact theek na ho
Fins par dhool jama ho jaye

solutions.en: Switch off power and let the IPM cool before opening the outdoor board.
solutions.ur: Outdoor board kholne se pehle power band kar ke IPM ko thanda hone dein.

solutions.en: Clean the heatsink fins and reseat the IPM with an even layer of paste; the contact must be flat.
solutions.ur: Heatsink fins saaf karein aur IPM par paste evenly laga kar dobara lagayein; contact bilkul flat hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Fix the outdoor fan and clearances; if it still overheats, replace the outdoor PCB.
solutions.ur: Outdoor fan aur clearances theek karein; phir bhi zyada garam ho to outdoor PCB badlein.

title.en: Compressor missing / reverse phase (U-MATCH alias of F6)
title.ur: Compressor missing / reverse phase (U-MATCH mein F6 ka alias)

meaning.en: Cannot sense compressor phases — shown as HE in U-MATCH troubleshooting (F6 in table).
meaning.ur: Compressor phases nahi dekh sakta — U-MATCH troubleshooting mein HE ke naam se aata hai (table mein F6).

solutions.en: Isolate mains power before testing the compressor terminals.
solutions.ur: Compressor ke terminals test karne se pehle mains power band karein.

solutions.en: Check the compressor terminals and winding continuity with a meter; windings should show continuity and no short to body.
solutions.ur: Meter se compressor ke terminals aur winding continuity check karein; winding continuity dikhai de aur body se short nahi hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the outdoor PCB if the windings are OK but the code stays.
solutions.ur: Windings theek hon aur code aaye to outdoor PCB badlein.

meaning.en: Optional indoor CO2 sensor failed (fresh-air packages).
meaning.ur: Indoor ka optional CO2 sensor kharab ho gaya (fresh-air package).

causes.ur: Module board se disconnect ho jaye

solutions.en: Power off the indoor unit before pulling the CO2 module.
solutions.ur: CO2 module nikalne se pehle indoor unit band karein.

solutions.en: Re-seat the module connector on the board and check the cable; the plug must be fully home.
solutions.ur: Board par module ka connector dobara lagayein aur cable check karein; plug poori tarah andar hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the CO2 module if it is still dead.
solutions.ur: Module ab bhi band ho to CO2 module badlein.

meaning.en: Fresh-air ventilation fan not running or no feedback.
meaning.ur: Fresh-air ventilation fan nahi chal raha ya uska feedback nahi aa raha.

solutions.en: Turn off power before inspecting the duct and fan.
solutions.ur: Duct aur fan check karne se pehle power band karein.

solutions.en: Check that the fan blade turns freely and the duct is not blocked; the motor should run without noise.
solutions.ur: Dekhein ke fan blade azaadi se ghoom raha ho aur duct band na ho; motor bina shor ke chalna chahiye.

solutions.en: Replace the fresh-air fan if it is jammed or the motor has failed.
solutions.ur: Fan atka ho ya motor kharab ho to fresh-air fan badlein.

meaning.en: Controller locked by access-control/settings protection (not a hardware fault).

causes.ur: Settings mein lockout function on ho jaye

solutions.en: Disable lock in controller settings
